summary: [Escalation] Intermittent truncated SSE stream on OpenAI-compatible endpoint for PaperKite (hosted)
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer escalation: some streamed completions end early (client sees normal token deltas, then connection closes without a [DONE] event).

Impact:
- Low to moderate: intermittent; retries usually succeed.

Initial findings:
- No corresponding model errors; serving runtime shows normal completion.
- Gateway access logs show client disconnects in many of the failed cases (499).

Resolution:
- Determined to be client-side timeout at 30s (their load balancer). Their prompts sometimes produce longer responses.
- Provided recommended keep-alive + timeout settings and advised increasing idle timeout for SSE.

Notes:
- Still counts as a streaming escalation mention, but root cause external.
comments: tessa_morgan (Support): Escalation noted. Asking for request ids + whether they are behind a proxy/LB.
dylan_brooks (SRE): Access logs show 499 (client closed request) for the truncated cases. No 5xx on our side.
tessa_morgan (Support): Customer confirmed they are behind Cloudflare with 30s idle timeout. Sharing SSE guidance.
tessa_morgan (Support): Customer increased idle timeout; issue no longer reproduces. Marking resolved.
